response.justification: The candidate is a versatile, experienced senior engineer with strong testing culture, some low-latency distributed systems work, and mentoring experience through workshops and courses. However, he falls far short of the core minimum qualification of 8 years of C++ experience (only a brief ~7-month C/C++ stint plus a thesis project), his career centers on web/full-stack work in TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang rather than large-scale cloud compute infrastructure, and he lacks formal technical-leadership experience managing cross-team priorities and deliverables at the scale this role requires.
strengths: Low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems experience (millions of requests/sec at Sociomantic/Dunnhumby)
Strong engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development, and testing tooling authorship
Demonstrated mentoring and knowledge-sharing via workshops, courses, and conference talks
concerns: Nowhere near the required 8 years of C++; primary languages are TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang
No formal technical-leadership role leading strategy, cross-team alignment, or project delivery
Limited production cloud architecture depth; cloud exposure is mostly application-level (AWS CDK, Kubernetes deployments)
